verdict: Ads paused three days; leads arriving but none reaching your pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 30 leads at a cost of $46.95 per lead — but advertising went dark September 9–11, producing zero new leads in that window. The more pressing issue is downstream: 24 contacts recorded in your CRM over this period resulted in zero opportunities created, meaning leads are coming in but not being converted into active cases. This is an intake problem, not an ads problem, and it traces directly to SMS automation and voice access that remain unresolved. Ads are being reactivated and the CRM intake gap is the immediate priority this week.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from Meta advertising
cost per lead this period, up from a July low near $19
opportunities created from 24 CRM contacts over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Your CRM has logged 24 contacts this period with zero converted to pipeline — leads are leaking at the intake stage.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and voice access are being resolved this week so contacts can be reached and logged as opportunities immediately upon arrival.
